newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sub Nigel says to form new listed firm.
newsitem.headline: Sub Nigel says to form new listed firm.

text.p: Sub Nigel Gold Mining Company Ltd said on Monday negotiations on the disposal of its mining interests have been inconclusive and that it was now considering forming a new company, Listco.
It said in a cautionary announcement that it was also considering plans for a wholly-owned subsidiary of Listco to acquire certain businesses in the information technology industry.
The company said it intended to apply to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for a Listco listing under the industrial "Electronics and Electrical" sector.
Sub Nigel said negotiations were still ongoing and a further announcement will follow in due course. The company warned shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings until further notice.
